title_zh: 周末打虎！中国东方电气集团原党组副书记、董事宋致远被查
title_en: Weekend Anti-Corruption: Song Zhiyuan, Former Dongfang Electric Deputy Party Secretary, Investigated
summary_zh: 8月8日，中国东方电气集团有限公司原党组副书记、董事宋致远因涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: On August 8, Song Zhiyuan, former Deputy Party Secretary and Director of Dongfang Electric Group, was placed under disciplinary review and supervision investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.
body_zh:
